infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ForageMate uses your location to show nearby foraging spots on the map and to automatically pin your location when adding a new spot. For example, if you find a fig tree near your local park, your current location will be used to place it accurately on the map.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: ForageMate uses your location to show nearby foraging spots on the map and to automatically pin your location when adding a new spot.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ForageMate uses your camera to photograph plants and foraging spots so other users can identify and locate them.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ForageMate lets you choose existing photos from your library to attach to foraging spot submissions.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: ForageMate saves foraging spot photos to your library.
